baseline.conditions: Raised river causeway; flood season can close the lower branch.

title: The high road has a price
daily_life: Reedbank kitchens buy flour and river households send repaired gear toward the junction. Flood marks on older stone tell the story of collective work, not a prophecy.
timing: The raised causeway and lower river branch are distinct. Closing the lower branch does not automatically close the high route; local observers decide each separately.
handoff: Before accepting a lower-branch instruction, compare its observation time with the bank marks. Do not relocate Floodglass Ford onto the main centreline simply to shorten a scene.
story_option: A courier pays for a high-route berth, then finds the receipt describes the closed lower branch. The error can be exploited by a broker without making the river a conspiracy.
production: Keep SITE-01 a separate local branch with no invented regional travel duration. Use the 3.3 habitat sheet if that encounter is staged.
direction: Listed a-to-b planning reference; reverse passage requires a fresh itinerary.
geometry: Regional endpoints and route length inherited; connecting line is not a surveyed track.
